text.en: Little by little, Canada took charge of its own affairs, as Australia and New Zealand did. In time, Canada could make an important contribution in the world.
text.fr: Petit à petit, le Canada a pris en main ses propres affaires, comme l'ont fait l'Australie et la Nouvelle-Zélande. Avec le temps, le Canada a pu apporter une contribution importante dans le monde.

source.quote: Like Australia, New Zealand and other countries, Canada developed its autonomy gradually with a capacity to make significant contributions internationally.

text.en: The Cold War began when several countries in eastern Europe, just freed, became part of a Communist bloc. The Soviet Union controlled that bloc, and Josef Stalin was its dictator.
text.fr: La guerre froide a commencé lorsque plusieurs pays de l'Europe de l'Est, tout juste libérés, sont entrés dans un bloc communiste. L'Union soviétique contrôlait ce bloc, et Josef Staline en était le dictateur.

source.quote: The Cold War began when several liberated countries of eastern Europe became part of a Communist bloc controlled by the Soviet Union under the dictator Josef Stalin.

text.en: Canada also became a member of international bodies. The United Nations, or UN, is one of them.
text.fr: Le Canada est aussi devenu membre d'organisations internationales. L'Organisation des Nations Unies, ou ONU, en est une.

source.quote: Canada joined international organizations such as the United Nations (UN).
